backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, affected files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing autogenerated summaries for all frontend components, pages, hooks, and layout files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, dark mode values, and global background/foreground styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file setting page metadata and loading the React app root and main script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with routes and a MetaUpdater that updates SEO tags on navigation.
frontend/src/components/CinematicBackgro: Canvas-based animated particle background with DPR scaling, reduced-motion handling, and visibility optimization.

frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with company info, quick links, contact details, social icons, and a bottom bar with credits.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the landing hero with branding, description, and CTA buttons that scroll to other sections or open WhatsApp.

frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Provides a sticky responsive header with navigation links and a toggleable mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/StickyButtons.ts: Adds fixed WhatsApp and call buttons for quick contact on all pages.
frontend/src/components/TransformationSe: Highlights fitness benefits with icons and a transformation teaser plus a WhatsApp CTA.
frontend/src/components/WelcomeSection.t: Introduces the academy with mission-focused text and a call-now CTA.
frontend/src/components/WhyChooseUs.tsx: Displays a themed section listing fitness academy benefits with icon cards and a call-to-action button.

frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and logic for Internet Identity authentication, including login state and stored identity handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useNearViewport.ts: Custom hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when an element approaches the viewport for lazy-loading.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend query methods exist.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles, color variables, animations, and utility classes for the site's visual theme.
frontend/src/layouts/SiteLayout.tsx: Main layout wrapping pages with header, footer, sticky buttons, and a memoized cinematic background.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point setting up React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page with hero section, story content, and value cards describing the fitness academy.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Renders a Contact page with hero section, quick contact cards, and location and timing information.
frontend/src/pages/CoursesPage.tsx: Renders the Courses page with a hero section and a list of course offerings including details and visuals.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Home page that mounts performance timers and lazy-loads multiple below-the-fold sections using DeferredSection.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Displays a styled 404 page with navigation buttons to go home or back.
frontend/src/seo/pageMeta.ts: Defines SEO metadata (title, description, keywords) for each route in the site.
frontend/src/utils/perf.ts: Provides dev-only performance timing and measurement helpers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, typography, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing current features, branding updates, and pending requests.
